newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen stable amid long weekend.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen stable amid long weekend.

text.p: The Warsaw bourse was expected to stay flat on Friday after Thursday's Corpus Christi holiday, with many investors taking a long weekend, analysts said.

Some analysts said a moderate growth was possible as bourse prices looked attractive with stocks trading at 15.5 times historic earnings, but said in the longer-term a horizontal trend was most likely.
Polish trading and financial firm Best SA starts bourse trade on the parallel market and some analysts expect the debut price below or at its issue price of 58 zlotys.
